title: Metadata catalog & classify worker
summary: DynamoDB-backed metadata catalog plus the worker role that decodes raw files and categorises every record.
goal: The worker consumes raw-files messages, stream-decodes each file, categorises every record (product_type, data_type) from the catalog, writes per-data_type staged files and transform messages, quarantines bad records and isolates poison files in the DLQ.
success_criteria: Catalog tables are created and seeded from a versioned file.
Catalog lookups are cached and coalesced.
A reusable SQS consumer handles concurrency, visibility heartbeats, retries and shutdown.
Files of any size stream through without loading fully into memory.
Bad records never fail a file; bad files end up in the DLQ with a ledger reason.
out_of_scope: Schema registry with versioned evolution beyond schema_version passthrough
